how: Axé Capoeira Chicago teaches adult, family and samba classes in West Town and advertises a $39 two-week introductory offer; Gingarte and Capoeira Angola FICA also hold Chicago classes.
About a dozen bowling alleys remain in the city, including Fireside Bowl (Logan Square) and Timber Lanes (North Center), plus Lucky Strike and 10Pin downtown.
Chicago Glass Collective lists glass blowing and blown-glass ornament classes (torch-based ornament workshop has no prerequisites); Ignite Glass Studios in Pilsen teaches furnace glassblowing.
Chicago Glass Collective lists Flameworking & Beadmaking classes and short Dabble! torch sessions.
Chicago Filmmakers runs adult classes in digital filmmaking, cinematography and lighting, editing and screenwriting.
Redline VR rents VR headsets by the hour with games such as Beat Saber and runs VR escape rooms.
CHAOS (Chicago Homebrew Alchemists of Suds) provides a shared brewhouse at 2417 W Hubbard with a 45-day trial membership and public monthly meetings.
The Chicago Weaving School in Irving Park teaches loom and basket weaving; The Weaving Workshop in Pilsen teaches basketry and off-loom weaving.
Chicagoland Games (Dice Dojo) lists weekly events for Warhammer and other miniatures games with play space.
Soham Dance Space (922 N Damen Ave) and Natya Dance Theatre list Bharatanatyam training; Natraj Dance Academy teaches it at north and northwest suburban locations.
Sandip Burman teaches tabla lessons in person in Chicagoland through The World Music Foundation, with tabla available to borrow.
Kinetic Mobility Arts (Ian Patete) posts weekly outdoor parkour classes at Humboldt Park and Ward Park with a first-class coupon.
Chicago Suburban Radio Association (W9SW) meets monthly in Westchester and Ham Radio Chicago (W9HRC) offers entry-level license classes and test sessions.
Chicagoland Games Dice Dojo in Edgewater hosts Magic: The Gathering prereleases and a Pokemon league; Good Games Chicago in Lincoln Park runs Magic and Pokemon league nights.
Weekly trivia runs at bars such as The Globe Pub (Tuesdays), Ramova Theatre Taproom (Sundays) and Hopleaf Bar.
Tsukasa Taiko at the Japanese American Service Committee ran introductory taiko classes and Kaiju Daiko lists amateur classes, but only dated (2006-2010) listings were found.
Eastend (Fulton Market) and Contrast Hot + Cold (738 N Milwaukee Ave) offer infrared sauna sessions; gyms such as Life Time River North have cedarwood and steam saunas.
Contrast Hot + Cold offers community or private-room cold plunge sessions paired with sauna; Eastend sells drop-in contrast therapy.
Many studios offer drop-in and membership yoga, e.g. Big Shoulders Yoga in Bucktown, Yoga Six and Half Moon Yoga in the South Loop.
Better Posture Pilates (West Loop) and Pilates Center of Chicago run reformer and mat classes; Centered Chicago and Half Moon Yoga combine yoga and mat Pilates.
The Chicago Area Runners Association (CARA) runs free weekday group runs, run crews, a Beginner 5K training program and marathon training.
Midwest Buddhist Temple in Chicago holds services and meditation sessions and welcomes visitors.
The Chicago Philatelic Society (founded 1886) holds monthly meetings, mostly over Zoom with an in-person November meeting, and runs the annual CHICAGOPEX stamp show in Itasca.
GONIL is the Chicago-area geocaching organisation that has held Cache-apalooza, cache-in-trash-out and picnic events at forest preserves such as Schiller Woods.

The Chicago Citywide Orchestra is an all-volunteer orchestra of amateur and retired musicians inviting players with their own instruments; Music Institute of Chicago runs a Community Symphony in Winnetka.
The Spa at Virgin Hotels (203 N Wabash) and Spa Space (West Loop) offer massages, and the Chicago School of Massage Therapy student clinic offered 60-minute massages.
Garfield Park Conservatory Alliance ran a Beginning Beekeeping class ($70) leading to its volunteer beekeeper program; Chicago Honey Co-op has run public classes at a rooftop apiary.
